in_marathi.name: Nilakshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Blue Lotus Eyed One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nilakshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'nilam' meaning blue, and 'akshi' meaning eye or vision. Nilakshi is a name for a girl with beautiful blue eyes, symbolizing wisdom and insight.
